item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
MELEMT 1.0

The first public release of MELEMT, a native Mac app for installing, managing and playing Mass Effect Legendary Edition mods.

  • Installs ME3Tweaks Mod Manager mods: Custom DLC, base game files, merge mods, TLK, 2DA, Coalesced and PlotManager merges, and texture overrides
  • Mod Manager Download links from Nexus Mods download and install straight into the app
  • Drop mod archives (.7z, .zip, .rar) on the window, or save them to Downloads
  • Sets each game up to load mods and backs up every original file it changes
  • Starts all three games through Steam (NotProton) or CrossOver, and hides everything else while you play
  • Launcher Mode for a clean window with just the games and their Play buttons
  • Custom cover and banner artwork for each game
  • Updates itself automatically

Requires macOS 27 or later.
